text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! Take a look at this!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The Earth!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Look at how vast it is. And did you
know? Races
are held not only in this
country where we live,
but also in
countries all across the world.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And it is across these oceans where I,
Seeking the
Pearl, will show off my
unlimited possibilities!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Craaash!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! Don't you think limiting a
pearl like
myself to just a single country
is a waste of
potential?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Because I do! And thus, after I conquer
the
Twinkle Series, I will set my sights on
the world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That is my grand plan! ♪ My destiny as
bestowed
unto me at birth!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl is the Umamusume I've
taken
under my wing. She was born in
America, boasts
unshakable confidence
in herself, and is capable
of running at
impressive speeds.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's the type to make bold
declarations, and her
big dream is to run
in races around the world.
However...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I know better than to consider her some

vainglorious clown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Behind her seemingly ridiculous ambition
lies her
true objective.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, isn't it obvious?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I've seen so many people in this world
who've lost
sight of their dreams. I want
to give these people
hope!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If the sight of me shrugging off any and
all
obstacles to grasp victory is
broadcast across the
globe...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Then the whole planet—from its
continents to its
many islands—will be
connected by my message,
unified under
the rainbow of possibility!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And to do so, I can't rely on my skill
alone. I must
dare to challenge the
impossible. Do you
understand?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl seeks to undertake
the
impossible and inspire courage in
people all over
the world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While she certainly does have first-class
skill,
that's not the reason that I chose to
be her
trainer. I did so because of how
much I admire her
lofty ambitions.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Trainer! Now is not the time to
be
smitten with my fabulousness.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's hurry back to Tracen Academy and
start
ironing out a detailed plan. It's
brainstorming
time!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
First, we must establish my main goal. I
expect
you already know what my true
aim is, correct?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her true goal... What kind of grand
achievement
would she have to
accomplish in order to show
the world
her potential? I hazard a guess.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm. You're close, but neither correct
nor
incorrect.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Sure, there are some international G1
races that
most would consider
impossible for me to win, but
more
specifically...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I want to be victorious in a European G1 race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She has a point. Victory in a European
G1 has
been a long-held dream of all
Tracen Academy
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race tracks in Europe use a different
kind of
turf and roadbed compared to
those in Japan,
and running on them
demands an incredible level
of
toughness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Because of this, many notable
Umamusume who
forced themselves into
racing in said unfamiliar
environment
ended up floundering in defeat.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That is precisely the kind of impossible feat I believe is worth achieving.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Not only that, but my soul speaks to
me... It tells
me that being the first to
win a European G1 race
is my promised
destiny!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her promised destiny... It only goes to
show how
strongly she feels about
achieving her true goal.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That'll do for my long-term goal. But
first things
first, we need to decide what
distance of race I
should run.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Tell me, Trainer... In your eyes, what
distance do
you deem me most fit for?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's certainly an interesting question. I
have no
doubts about her unparalleled
speed, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That isn't her only strength—she also
possesses
remarkable adaptability and
range.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Sure, 2,000 meters would be no
problem for me...
but what would you
say to 2,400 meters?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
In other words, it'd be a close call if I ran
in
those... Got it. Well then, in that
case...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Not only can I run in miles and sprints in
the
Twinkle Series, but I can also aim for
the Triple
Tiara. Is that what you're
trying to say?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The second race of the Triple Tiara, the
Japanese
Oaks, measures 2,400 meters
long and may
prove to be a challenge,
but as long as she can
clear that, then
anything's possible for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If her goal is to make her way onto the
world
stage, there are plenty of
different routes she can
take to reach
that destination.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
So, the Triple Tiara is one option. And if
I am to
run in miles and sprints...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Then the Umamusume who will be my
greatest
roadblock is undoubtedly...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeeehaaaw!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy, Pearl! Congrats on enterin' the
Twinkle
Series!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Let's do our best as racin' partners!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like a plan! As racers of the same

generation, I'll be sure to show you
ample
amounts of love!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl laughs loudly, but
beneath her
confidence, she knows all
too well who her
biggest threat is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle. She's a fellow
American-born
Umamusume, and a
gunslinging miler with a sunny

personality to boot. But most
importantly...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She'll be Seeking the Pearl's inevitable
rival if she
chooses to pursue sprint and
mile races.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha. There's no need to look so
nervous,
Trainer. Sure, Taiki may possess
terrifying skill
and speed...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But nothing's impossible when it comes
to me.
The higher the hurdle, the
greater the chance I
have to show off my
possibilities, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She absolutely has a point. Her goal is to
make
the impossible possible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she doesn't take on seemingly
impossible
challenges, she'll never
achieve her
dream—whether it be
running in the Triple Tiara,
or facing
Taiki Shuttle.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
All you have to do is believe in me.
Believe in me
from the bottom of your
heart!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If you do that, our path will lead to
glory. So,
come! Let's go and seek the
shining pearl of our
future!
